messages.author: ef67b2cc516f25b0
messages.subject: Set Up
parts:
So, I've set up R studio and shiny server on a VPS. I installed Apache to allow access through http1.2.3/rstudio/ and http1.2.3/shiny/.  Both of these work fine and I can log into R studio and also see sample page at Shiny.
However I want to know how I set up so that when I create an app in R studio, for example in location shinyapp/my_app it becomes visible at http1.2.3/shiny/my_app ?

Thanks for the help.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Set Up
parts:
This is about as close as you can get to having this happen "automatically":
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#host-per-user-application-directories

Though we'll have a different solution later this year that will give you push-button Shiny deployment from any RStudio IDE in your organization. Stay tuned for that.
